time.vector_ticks: exact fixture-relative rational coordinates, closed sets; not system clock

ivan.naming_evidence: explicit fixture identity binding, not spelling similarity

known.required_registered_senses: all non-OPEN predicate symbols used by selected cases; mapping and roles pinned independently
known.provider: FAKE scripted, requests recorded, selected sense/role pinned by case

release_validation.recipe: construct one valid entry per selected resource schema from source fixture builder; sign canonical release payload; mutate exactly the stated dimension after signing when testing tampering

VALID_LOCAL.scope: only declared fixture-local frames/roles and raw spans

binding_policy.actual_uids: independent fixture builder records Ref map before run
binding_policy.candidate_ids: compute from fixture producers and canonical payload per §1.3, not learn from SUT
binding_policy.hashes: hash actual fixture bytes and independently built initial/gold snapshots; never zero/guessed hashes
binding_policy.extra_actual_nodes: must be exported with unbound:<uid> aliases, never filtered away
binding_policy.scope_identity: typed AST including occurrence and variable scope; not rendered text
binding_policy.event_occurrences: alias includes observation/goal path key; content equality is not event identity
binding_policy.stage_tests: component cases cannot count as full G3/G4/G5 pipeline success

registered_templates.uid_policy: real UID returned by fixture AH template creation; record in binding manifest before SUT
